first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making a focused onboarding simplification test the most direct response to the current funnel deterioration. Verify the prior evidence for shortened onboarding and reduced signup friction before committing. Run a guarded test with qualified-pipeline, conversion quality, and retention guardrails so improved completion does not come at the expense of sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented onboarding simplification experiment this week, prioritizing shortened onboarding because it improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention. Incorporate signup-field reduction only for SMBs, where evidence supports activation gains, while monitoring its observed 30-day retention decline. Use qualified revenue, activation, completion, time-to-value, and retention guardrails; do not roll out broadly until downstream value is confirmed.
